einzeiler: Lewis Howes on overcoming fear, healing past trauma, and shifting your mindset.
kurzfassung: Lewis Howes discusses how childhood trauma and the fear of judgment fueled his early success while leaving him emotionally exhausted. He shares strategies for overcoming fear, self-doubt, and unresolved pain to build fulfilling achievement. The discussion also covers defining greatness, shifting from a powerless mindset, and beginning the self-healing process.
stichpunkte: Rebuilding life and career after a career-ending injury
Leveraging LinkedIn and launching The School of Greatness podcast
Defining greatness and finding a profitable mission
Contrasting the powerless mindset with the greatness mindset
Overcoming fear, self-doubt, and the ego
Building an identity around your future self
Approaches to beginning self-healing from past trauma
beschreibung:
Lewis Howes embarked on a self-healing journey and completely shifted his mindset after realizing that childhood trauma, fear of judgment, and the need to prove people wrong were fueling his success but leaving him emotionally exhausted. Even after building a successful business and podcast, achievement could not fix what he had buried. By healing past wounds and grounding his life in service and a meaningful mission, he found a healthier path to greatness. In this episode, Lewis shares how to overcome fear, self-doubt, and unresolved pain while building success that actually feels fulfilling.

Lewis Howes is a New York Times bestselling author, entrepreneur, keynote speaker, and former professional athlete. He is the host of The School of Greatness, a top business and self-development podcast where he interviews leaders across entrepreneurship, health, mindset, sports, science, and entertainment. Through his work, he helps people improve the quality of their lives and pursue meaningful success.
